standard_tools: apply_for_credit_card submit_referral get_referrals never unlock
dual_product_open: open/apply every product then optional transfer
referral_max_bonus: highest referrer under deposit threshold; verify then submit
discoverable_user: give name-only then user call per txn
cli: deny pay approve not transfer
enums: no Business Checking suffixes; no (savings) parentheticals
